title: fix(runtime, metadata-protocol): the permission-set clone door copies a set that grants on an object this deployment does not install, and member_default's feed grants re-land

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 两件事放在一个 PR 里：一是把 #30108 重新落地（`member_default` 授予 `sys_comment` 读建改、`sys_activity` 读，与 #30222 逐字节相同）；二是修权限集克隆门：副本从源集合继承来的授权键交给保存门，保存门的未知对象拒收不再审这些键。
- **为什么改：** #30222 合入后 main 红了。没装审计插件的部署里，这两个对象没有注册，克隆 `member_default` 会被 422 拒收。上个 PR #30262 先回退止血，这个 PR 把功能和修复一起带回来。
- **风险与回滚：** 拒收门只放过「副本从源集合原样继承」的键；副本新加的未知对象、`/meta` 保存、草稿发布，照拒不误。`saveMetaItem` 的请求多了一个可选键，在 metadata-protocol 的公开类型里可达，所以申报 Clause-② yes (widening)。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` 新增的过滤，再看 `packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts` 第 7 步保存。
- **两分钟验证：** 在 `packages/qa/dogfood` 跑 `pnpm exec vitest run test/permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts`（依赖先构建），预期 11 条全绿。
- **需要您做的：** 无，席位按 Clause-② yes 安排契约复审后落地。

Fixes #30255
Fixes #30108

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.saveMetaItem`'s request gains one optional key, `inheritedGrantObjects`, reachable from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `.` entry types
Metadata-protocol: none

## Why main went red, measured

Run 41961254209 (`797f9257`), `Dogfood Regression Gate (2/3)`, case `permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts` "a platform set (the lock-and-clone rule's commonest source) copies into its shipping package's pair": `422 INVALID_METADATA` with two findings, `objects.sys_comment` and `objects.sys_activity`, each "no package registers an object of that name and none is saved here".

- `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack` constructs no `AuditPlugin` (fact 3 of `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-audit-registration.contract.test.ts`), and the showcase's `requires` does not name `audit`. So neither object is registered on that boot. `sys_inbox_message` and `sys_notification_receipt`, which `member_default` already granted, pass because the showcase requires `messaging`.
- The save door's unknown-grant refusal (#28990) judges every grant of a NEW item, and a clone is a new item. Its docblock assumed that platform objects are always registered. That does not hold for an optional platform plugin.
- Not dogfood-only: any deployment that does not install `@objectstack/plugin-audit` could not clone `member_default` once #30222 landed.

## What changes

**The clone door is told which grants it inherits** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts`). Step 7's `saveMetaItem` call passes `inheritedGrantObjects: inheritedGrantObjectsOf(clone)`, which is the keys of the copy's `objects` map. `clonePermissionSetDefinition` carries every one of them unchanged from the source.

**The refusal leaves inherited grants to the source's save** (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`):

- `protocol-door-requests.ts`: `SaveMetaItemRequest` gains `inheritedGrantObjects?: readonly string[]`, documented as server-set only.
- `protocol-save.ts`: the save path forwards it to the refusal. Draft and publish mode are both covered, and a `migrate-stored` save is still exempt as before.
- `protocol.ts` and `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`: `unknownGrantObjectSaveRefusal` takes it as a trailing parameter and drops those keys from the unknown list, after the existing "the set's current definition already grants on it" step. This is that rule applied to a copy: the grant was introduced by the source and is judged where the source introduced it. The method's docblock gains the bullet.
- Unchanged: an unknown object the save does not say it inherits is refused exactly as before. That covers a `/meta` save, a re-save that adds a grant, a copy that adds one, and a draft's publish (`promoteDraftForPublish` and the restore doors pass no inherited set). No HTTP door forwards the key: `PUT /meta` builds its request field by field.

**#30108 re-landed:** reverting `119c2db1` (PR #30262, the revert) restores `member_default`'s two grants, their tests and their changeset. `git diff 490d136f HEAD` over those five paths is empty apart from the changeset's one added bullet, which says the grant now lands with this fix. #30108's measurements are in PR #30222's body.

**Changesets:** `.changeset/30108-member-default-feed-grants.md` (restored, `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch, with one bullet added that names this fix) and `.changeset/30255-clone-inherits-held-grants.md` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/runtime` patch, both declaration lines).

## Clause-②, measured

`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `exports` map has one entry, `.`, typed by `./dist/index.d.ts` and `./dist/index.d.cts`. Built on this tree, `dist/index.d.ts` declares `SaveMetaItemRequest` (a non-exported alias) with `inheritedGrantObjects?: readonly string[]`, and the exported class `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`'s `saveMetaItem(request: SaveMetaItemRequest)` references it. So the key is reachable from the entry's type graph: a widening of the published surface. Nothing a metadata author writes changes, so `Metadata-protocol: none`.

<details><summary>Ablations (4 legs, each restored and proven by blob hash against HEAD)</summary>

Driven through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, under `os-verify-lock`), on head `591198e4`.

| Leg | Mutation | Red cases |
|:--|:--|:--|
| F1 | the refusal ignores `inherited` | 1: the new metadata-protocol case (the copy is refused on its inherited grant) |
| F2 | the save path drops `request.inheritedGrantObjects` | 1: the same case |
| F3 | the clone door omits `inheritedGrantObjects` | 2: the two clone-door pins that assert the save request's exact key set and the key's value |
| F4 | `inherited` widened to every grant of the item | 1: the new case's second half (a grant the copy adds is still refused) |

The dogfood half of F3 is `main`'s own red: with the grants landed and no fix, the clone-door case answered 422 (runs 41960290148 and 41961254209).
